mapper.sql: id, event_key, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_until, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_outbox (event_key, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_until) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{leaseUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE vi_outbox SET status = 'DONE', lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE vi_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'READY' END, attempts = #{attempts}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE vi_outbox SET status = 'READY', lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}
